Main Screen Touch the clock in the center to add an alarm, and check history and settings at the top right.
Clock Controls • Tap: Open alarm settings\n• Double Tap: Cancel all alarms\n• Double Tap: Stop ringing alarm\n• Long Press: Restart recent alarms with vibration
Settings Icons Guide ⏳ : Toggle Timer (Relative) Mode\n📈 : Gradual Volume Increase (Crescendo)\n♾️ : Repeat until dismissed\n🗣️ : Text-To-Speech (TTS)
Detailed Alarm Settings Customize relative time, volume, duration, and crescendo to your liking.
Save & Share Routines Save your perfect alarm settings as a preset\nand share them with friends via cool receipts & QR codes!
App Settings Adjust background transparency or view this tutorial again anytime.
